projects.name: WorkQueue - Distributed Task Queue
projects.description: Asynchronous task queue where jobs submitted through FastAPI endpoints are queued in Redis and consumed by background workers using BRPOP. Features process-level parallelism via ProcessPoolExecutor, automatic retries with exponential backoff, Dead Letter Queue (DLQ), Pydantic validation, and worker heartbeats.

projects.name: URL Shortener API
projects.description: RESTful URL Shortener with JWT auth, password hashing, and Redis token blocklist for server-side logout. Features async PostgreSQL database queries, 1-hour TTL Redis redirect lookup caching, collision-resistant short code generation, ownership access control, visit tracking, and Alembic database migrations.

projects.name: AI-Based Health Emergency Detection System
projects.description: Wearable health monitoring device using ESP32 to track heart rate, SpO2, body temperature, and real-time motion. Features fall-detection, emergency alerts, and a machine learning classification model trained on accelerometer data, streaming metrics wirelessly over BLE GATT.

experience.company: Pragyatmika - Centre of Excellence for IoT, MCET
